description.text: Battle Academy (对战学院) is a box for starting the game, released in Simplified Chinese on 16 January 2026. It holds four new ready-to-play 60-card decks, built around Sprigatito ex, Pikachu ex, Greninja ex and Lucario ex, with eight holo Pokémon ex between them; each deck repeats cards as it needs. A beginner's guide helps children learn the game with their parents or guardians, from the basics to setting up and the rules, and the box also has a Pokémon coin, a sheet of damage counters with Poison and Burn markers, and four bands for keeping the decks apart. Its cards are numbered out of 66; the basic Energy print their type code instead of a number.
